passage: Maria had always enjoyed reading books about space exploration. Every afternoon after school, she visited the local library to learn more about astronauts, planets, and distant galaxies. One day, she discovered a book about the first moon landing. The story inspired her deeply, and she began dreaming of becoming an aerospace engineer. Maria started studying science more seriously and joined her school's robotics club. Although the work was challenging, she remained determined to achieve her goal.
